The unchanged original logger runs with 0x54139c, 0x5413a0 and 0x5413a8 cleared to avoid formatted diagnostic UI paths.
The slow blit accepts a null source initially but a successful surface-lost restore requires a nonnull source for its unconditional retry dereference.
The preserved legacy app implementation remains elected, while this new canonical module is source-only and is not yet joined into the app.
